components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;color:var(--ink,#20362e)}.ds-field label{font:14px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-field input{font:16px system-ui,sans-serif;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:50px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #859185;border-radius:0;background:#fcfbf7;color:var(--ink,#20362e);caret-color:var(--blue,#3866a7);accent-color:var(--blue,#3866a7)}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:var(--blue,#3866a7)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#3866a7);outline-offset:6px}.ds-field small{font:12px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#4c6055)}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4.8vw;border-left:1px solid var(--rule,#65716a);padding:.7vw 3.8vw;font:1.43vw Georgia,serif;color:var(--ink,#20362e)}.ds-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--blue,#3866a7)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#3866a7);outline-offset:6px}@media(max-width:900px){.ds-nav{justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;border:0;padding:0;font-size:15px}.ds-nav a{padding:10px 0}}

narrative.northStar: The Property Lookbook (homepage); The Open House (retained service pages)
narrative.overview: Approved homepage uses navy, ivory, blue actions, self-hosted Manrope and Playfair, real supplied photographs, and aligned content gutters. Existing service pages retain the forest/cream shared system, Georgia navigation/actions, and system-ui practical text. Homepage-specific tokens do not redefine global styling.
keyCharacteristics: Authentic supplied photographs and existing logo.
Square actions, fine rules, open columns.
Property-led homepage with prominent home routes.

rules.name: Scoped homepage extension
rules.body: Apply home-* tokens within .commercial-home; shared/service tokens remain accurate for their existing surfaces.

rules.name: Flat surface rule
rules.body: Use rules, space and tonal fields rather than lifted cards.

dos: Preserve supplied logo and real-photo sources.
Keep matched oven framing and aligned desktop gutters.
Keep active Formspree inquiry submission, phone alternatives, focus and reduced motion.
donts: Do not imply global service styles were redesigned.
Do not call the active quote form disabled or promise booking availability.
Do not present generated concept imagery as actual cleaning evidence.
